name: toddwschneider/sec-13f-filings
what_it_holds: Ruby on Rails app (MIT, 438 stars) with a schema (thirteen_fs / holdings / aggregate_holdings tables) and scripts that import and parse SEC 13F XML filings from 2014 onward for any manager CIK you specify; the live instance (13f.info) already tracks large holders such as Berkshire Hathaway quarterly. No CUSIP-ticker mapping bundled (licensing), but the parser and schema are complete.
why_useful: Turns raw 13F XML into a queryable holdings-history database -- lets us build ABNB institutional-ownership concentration/turnover history (fund entries/exits, hedge fund vs long-only mix) as a positioning read ahead of the Q4 guide, complementing the options-chain and short-interest data already held.
